make install with PREFIX installs the binary (0755) and man page (0644) under DESTDIR/PREFIX; without PREFIX it go-installs the binary and copies the man page to USER_MANDIR. USER_MANDIR is not defined anywhere in the repo, so a plain `make install` runs `install -d ""` and fails before the man page is installed (likely bug)
make uninstall removes what make install put down, for both the PREFIX and the per-user layout
make run / format / analyze run the binary with ARGS, gofmt -w the tree, and run golangci-lint
